5	function hashPassword(password: string): string {

11	/**
12	 * Create and configure the Express application.
13	 */
14	export function createApp(): express.Application {
15	  const app = express();
16	
17	  // ── Middleware chain (order matters) ──────────────────────
18	  // 1. TraceId — must be first so all subsequent handlers have req.traceId
19	  app.use(traceIdMiddleware);
20	
21	  // 2. Request logging
22	  app.use(requestLoggerMiddleware);
23	
24	  // 3. Security headers (helmet)
25	  app.use(helmet());
26	
27	  // 4. CORS — explicit whitelist
28	  app.use(corsMiddleware);
29	
30	  // 5. Cookie parser (needed for CSRF cookie)
31	  app.use(cookieParser());
32	
33	  // 6. JSON body parser
34	  app.use(express.json({ limit: "1mb" }));
35	
36	  // 7. CSRF protection (mutating methods only)
37	  app.use(csrfMiddleware);
38	
39	  // ── Routes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
40	  app.use(healthRouter);
41	
42	  // ── 404 catch-all ─────────────────────────────────────────
43	  app.use((_req, res) => {
44	    res.status(404).json({
45	      error: {
46	        code: "NOT_FOUND",
47	        message: "请求的资源不存在",
48	      },
49	    });
50	  });
51	
52	  // ── Unified error handler (must be last) ──────────────────
53	  app.use(errorHandlerMiddleware);
54	
55	  return app;
56	}

1	import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
2	import { logger } from "./logger";

4	/**
5	 * Application-level error with code for unified error responses.
6	 */
7	export class AppError extends Error {
8	  public readonly code: string;
9	  public readonly statusCode: number;
10	  public readonly details?: unknown;
11	
12	  constructor(
13	    code: string,
14	    message: string,
15	    statusCode: number = 500,
16	    details?: unknown
17	  ) {
18	    super(message);
19	    this.code = code;
20	    this.statusCode = statusCode;
21	    this.details = details;
22	    this.name = "AppError";
23	  }
24	}
25	
26	/**
27	 * Unified error response format: { error: { code, message, details? } }
28	 */
29	export function errorHandlerMiddleware(
30	  err: Error,
31	  req: Request,
32	  res: Response,
33	  _next: NextFunction
34	): void {
35	  // Known application errors
36	  if (err instanceof AppError) {
37	    logger.warn(
38	      { err, traceId: req.traceId },
39	      `AppError: ${err.code} - ${err.message}`
40	    );
41	    res.status(err.statusCode).json({
42	      error: {
43	        code: err.code,
44	        message: err.message,
45	        ...(err.details ? { details: err.details } : {}),
46	      },
47	    });
48	    return;
49	  }
50	
51	  // Unknown errors — log full stack trace, return generic message
52	  logger.error(
53	    { err, traceId: req.traceId },
54	    `Unhandled error: ${err.message}`
55	  );
56	
57	  res.status(500).json({
58	    error: {
59	      code: "INTERNAL_ERROR",
60	      message:
61	        process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
62	          ? "服务器内部错误，请稍后重试"
63	          : err.message,
64	    },
65	  });
66	}

1	import { createApp } from "./app";

4	import { config } from "./config";

7	/**
8	 * Verify the database connection and bring the schema up to date.
9	 * On failure the server still starts (in degraded mode) so the health
10	 * endpoint can report the outage rather than crashing the process.
11	 */
12	async function initializeDatabase(): Promise<void> {
13	  try {
14	    const db = getDb();
15	    await db.raw("SELECT 1");
16	    logger.info("Database connection established successfully");
17	
18	    await runMigrations();
19	    await runSeedIfEmpty();
20	  } catch (err) {
21	    logger.error(
22	      { err },
23	      "Failed to initialize database — server starting in degraded mode"
24	    );
25	  }
26	}
27	
28	async function main(): Promise<void> {
29	  const app = createApp();
30	
31	  await initializeDatabase();
32	
33	  const server = app.listen(config.port, () => {
34	    logger.info(
35	      `Server started on port ${config.port} [${config.env}]`,
36	    );
37	    logger.info(`Health check: http://localhost:${config.port}/api/v1/health`);
38	  });
39	
40	  // Graceful shutdown
41	  const shutdown = async (signal: string) => {
42	    logger.info(`${signal} received — shutting down gracefully`);
43	    server.close(async () => {
44	      await closeDb();
45	      logger.info("Server closed");
46	      process.exit(0);
47	    });
48	
49	    // Force exit after 10s
50	    setTimeout(() => {
51	      logger.error("Forced shutdown after timeout");
52	      process.exit(1);
53	    }, 10000);
54	  };
55	
56	  process.on("SIGTERM", () => shutdown("SIGTERM"));
57	  process.on("SIGINT", () => shutdown("SIGINT"));
58	}
59	
60	main().catch((err) => {
61	  logger.error({ err }, "Failed to start server");
62	  process.exit(1);
63	});

1	import { getDb } from "./connection";
2	import { config } from "../config";
3	import { logger } from "../middleware/logger";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Directories for migrations and seeds. In development the TypeScript sources
7	 * are run directly (via ts-node); in production the compiled JS is used.
8	 */
9	const migrationsDirectory = config.isProd
10	  ? "./dist/db/migrations"
11	  : "./src/db/migrations";
12	const seedsDirectory = config.isProd ? "./dist/db/seeds" : "./src/db/seeds";
13	const extension = config.isProd ? "js" : "ts";
14	
15	/**
16	 * Apply all pending database migrations. Idempotent — safe to run on every
17	 * startup; already-applied migrations are skipped.
18	 */
19	export async function runMigrations(): Promise<void> {
20	  const db = getDb();
21	  const [batchNo, log] = await db.migrate.latest({
22	    directory: migrationsDirectory,
23	    extension,
24	  });
25	
26	  if (log.length === 0) {
27	    logger.info("No pending migrations — database schema is up to date");
28	  } else {
29	    logger.info(
30	      `Applied ${log.length} migration(s) (batch ${batchNo}): ${log.join(", ")}`
31	    );
32	  }
33	}
34	
35	/**
36	 * Seed the database only if it is empty. Guards against re-truncating user
37	 * data on every server restart.
38	 */
39	export async function runSeedIfEmpty(): Promise<void> {
40	  const db = getDb();
41	
42	  const existingUser = await db("users").first("id");
43	  if (existingUser) {
44	    logger.info("Seed skipped — database already contains data");
45	    return;
46	  }
47	
48	  const [log] = await db.seed.run({
49	    directory: seedsDirectory,
50	    extension,
51	  });
52	  logger.info(`Seeded database: ${log.join(", ")}`);
53	}
54

104	  collapsible?: boolean;
105	  defaultCollapsed?: boolean;
106	  visibilityCondition?: ConditionNode | null;
107	  fields: FieldSchema[];
108	}
109	
110	/** The typed intermediate representation produced by SchemaParser. */
111	export interface ParsedSchema {
112	  schemaVersion: string;
113	  sections: SectionSchema[];
114	  approvalChain?: ApprovalChain;
115	}
116	
117	// ── Conditions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
118	
119	export const CONDITION_OPERATORS = [
120	  "equals",
121	  "notEquals",
122	  "contains",
123	  "notContains",
124	  "greaterThan",
125	  "lessThan",
126	  "isEmpty",
127	  "isNotEmpty",
128	  "in",
129	  "notIn",
130	] as const;
131	
132	export type ConditionOperator = (typeof CONDITION_OPERATORS)[number];
133	
134	/** A single atomic condition. */
135	export interface LeafCondition {
136	  fieldId: string;
137	  operator: ConditionOperator;
138	  value?: unknown;
139	}
140	
141	/**
142	 * A condition group. `type` is optional in the MVP (a bare `{ conditions: [...] }`
143	 * is implicitly AND). Phase 2 adds explicit AND/OR support; the MVP evaluator
144	 * rejects `"or"` (see ADR-0006), but the type admits it for forward-compat.
145	 */
146	export interface AndCondition {
147	  type?: "and" | "or";
148	  conditions: ConditionNode[];
149	}
150	
151	export type ConditionNode = LeafCondition | AndCondition;
152	
153	// ── Values & errors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
154	
155	export type FormValues = Record<string, unknown>;
156	
157	export interface FieldError {
158	  /** The rule/type that failed, e.g. "required", "minLength", "crossField". */
159	  rule: string;
160	  /** Human-readable message (Chinese in the MVP). */
161	  message: string;
162	}
163	
164	/**
165	 * Errors keyed by field id. Nested (subform) errors use a dotted path key,
166	 * e.g. `"subformFieldId.0.childFieldId"` for row 0 of a subform.
167	 */
168	export type AllErrors = Record<string, FieldError[]>;
169	
170	// ── Approval ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
171	
172	export const APPROVAL_STATES = [
173	  "draft",
174	  "submitted",
175	  "in_approval",
176	  "approved",
177	  "rejected",
178	  "returned",
179	  "withdrawn",
180	] as const;
181	
182	export type ApprovalState = (typeof APPROVAL_STATES)[number];
183	
184	export const APPROVAL_ACTION_TYPES = [
185	  "submit",
186	  "approve",
187	  "reject",
188	  "return",
189	  "withdraw",
190	  "transfer",
191	] as const;
192	
193	export type ApprovalActionType = (typeof APPROVAL_ACTION_TYPES)[number];
194	
195	export type ApprovalAction =
196	  | { type: "submit" }
197	  | { type: "approve"; isFinal: boolean }
198	  | { type: "reject" }
199	  | { type: "return" }
200	  | { type: "withdraw" }
201	  | { type: "transfer"; targetUserId?: string };
202	
203	// ── Approver resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
204	
205	export interface User {
206	  id: string;
207	  name: string;
208	  email?: string;
209	  departmentId?: string | null;
210	  managerId?: string | null;
211	  roles?: string[];
212	  isActive?: boolean;
213	}
214	
215	export type ApproverRule =
216	  | { type: "org_structure"; relation: "direct_manager" | "department_manager" }
217	  | { type: "role"; roleId: string }
218	  | { type: "specific"; userId: string };
219	
220	export interface ApprovalNode {
221	  id: string;
222	  order: number;
223	  label?: string;
224	  approverRule: ApproverRule;
225	}
226	
227	export interface ApprovalChain {
228	  nodes: ApprovalNode[];
229	}
230	
231	/**
232	 * Read-only organizational data source. The engine consumes this interface to
233	 * resolve approvers; it never mutates org data (CONTEXT.md "OrgDataSource").
234	 *
235	 * Note: `getUsersByRole` is required for the `role` rule type (design spec §6.4);
236	 * it was omitted from the §6.6 interface listing, so we include it here.
237	 */
238	export interface OrgDataSource {
239	  getUser(id: string): Promise<User | null>;
240	  searchUsers(query: string): Promise<User[]>;
241	  getUserManager(userId: string): Promise<User | null>;
242	  getUsersByDepartment(departmentId: string): Promise<User[]>;
243	  getUsersByRole(roleId: string): Promise<User[]>;
244	}
245	
246	// ── Form runtime state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
247	
248	export interface FormState {
249	  values: FormValues;
250	  errors: AllErrors;
251	  visibility: Record<string, boolean>;
252	  disabled: Record<string, boolean>;
253	  touched: Record<string, boolean>;
254	  dirty: boolean;
255	  submitting: boolean;
256	}
257	
258	export type FormAction =
259	  | { type: "SET_VALUE"; fieldId: string; value: unknown }
260	  | { type: "BLUR"; fieldId: string }
261	  | { type: "SET_ERRORS"; errors: AllErrors }
262	  | { type: "SET_DISABLED"; fieldId: string; disabled: boolean }
263	  | { type: "SET_SUBMITTING"; submitting: boolean }
264	  | { type: "VALIDATE_ALL" }
265	  | { type: "RESET" }
266	  | { type: "RESTORE"; state: FormState };
267
```

2	 * API client configuration.
3	 * All API requests go through this centralized base URL.
4	 *
5	 * VITE_API_BASE_URL is set via environment variable or defaults to /api/v1.
6	 */
7	export const API_BASE_URL: string =
8	  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "/api/v1";
9	
10	/**
11	 * Get the CSRF token from the non-httpOnly cookie.
12	 * The CSRF cookie is set by the server and readable by client-side JS.
13	 *
14	 * IMPORTANT: The cookie name "xsrf-token" must match the server's
15	 * CSRF_COOKIE_NAME config (default: "xsrf-token", configurable via env).
16	 */
17	function getCsrfToken(): string {
18	  const match = document.cookie.match(
19	    /(?:^|;\s*)xsrf-token=([^;]*)/
20	  );
21	  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : "";
22	}
23	
24	export class ApiError extends Error {
25	  public readonly statusCode: number;
26	  public readonly code: string;
27	
28	  constructor(statusCode: number, code: string, message: string) {
29	    super(message);
30	    this.name = "ApiError";
31	    this.statusCode = statusCode;
32	    this.code = code;
33	  }
34	}
35	
36	/**
37	 * Typed fetch wrapper for API calls.
38	 * Automatically injects CSRF token for mutating requests.
39	 * All requests include credentials (cookies).
40	 */
41	export async function apiClient<T>(
42	  path: string,
43	  options: RequestInit = {}
44	): Promise<T> {
45	  const url = `${API_BASE_URL}${path}`;
46	
47	  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
48	    "Content-Type": "application/json",
49	    ...((options.headers as Record<string, string>) || {}),
50	  };
51	
52	  // Inject CSRF token for mutating requests
53	  const method = (options.method || "GET").toUpperCase();
54	  if (!["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"].includes(method)) {
55	    const csrfToken = getCsrfToken();
56	    if (csrfToken) {
57	      headers["X-CSRF-Token"] = csrfToken;
58	    }
59	  }
60	
61	  const response = await fetch(url, {
62	    ...options,
63	    headers,
64	    credentials: "include",
65	  });
66	
67	  if (!response.ok) {
68	    let errorBody: { error?: { code?: string; message?: string } } = {};
69	    try {
70	      errorBody = await response.json();
71	    } catch {
72	      // Response is not JSON
73	    }
74	    throw new ApiError(
75	      response.status,
76	      errorBody.error?.code || "UNKNOWN",
77	      errorBody.error?.message || response.statusText
78	    );
79	  }
80	
81	  // 204 No Content
82	  if (response.status === 204) {
83	    return undefined as T;
84	  }
85	
86	  return response.json();
87	}
88
```

```text
1	# 动态表单引擎 — 领域词汇表
2	
3	> 本文档定义系统中的核心术语。它是语义的唯一权威来源——当代码、设计文档、对话中使用这些词时，必须与此处定义一致。
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 核心实体
8	
9	### FormTemplate（表单模板）
10	
11	设计者创建的表单定义。包含表单结构（Schema）、审批链配置、分类、版本号。模板是配置的**单一事实来源**，引擎将其翻译为 UI 和行为。
12	
13	**状态**：`draft`（编辑中）→ `published`（已发布，用户可填写）→ `archived`（已归档，不可新建实例）
14	
15	> 模板**不存在审批流程**。质量保障通过环境晋升实现：UAT 充分测试 → PROD 迁移。参见 `docs/requirement-spec-form-engine.md` v1.1 第 3 节。
16	
17	### FormInstance（表单实例）
18	
19	用户提交表单时创建的运行时记录。绑定提交时刻的模板快照（`template_snapshot`），后续模板变更不影响已有实例。
20	
21	**状态**：`draft` → `submitted` → `in_approval` → `approved` | `rejected` | `returned` | `withdrawn`
22	
23	### ApprovalRecord（审批记录）
24	
25	审批链上一个审批节点的执行记录。实例提交时创建第一条，审批流转时逐节点创建。
26	
27	**动作**：`pending` → `approved` | `rejected` | `returned` | `transferred`
28	
29	### Draft（草稿）
30	
31	用户未完成填写的中间状态。与 Instance 的 `draft` 状态不同：Draft 是独立实体，`field_values` 为部分填写内容。草稿保留 2 年，超期清除。
32	
33	**版本不匹配**：打开草稿时若模板已更新，基于 fieldId 尽力映射——匹配的值迁移，不匹配的移入 `_orphaned` 对象。界面顶部黄色提示。
34	
35	**自动保存**：onBlur + 30s 定时兜底 + dirty 检测。无变更时不请求。
36	
37	### Notification（通知）
38	
39	关键业务事件触发的消息。**at-most-once 实时投递**（SSE push），**at-least-once 持久化**（数据库 INSERT）。两者走不同的可靠路径。
40	
41	**渠道适配器**：投递层使用适配器模式——MVP 仅 `InAppChannel`。后续可插拔 Email、企微等渠道，不影响核心逻辑。
42	
43	### OrgDataSource（组织架构数据源）
44	
45	用户数据和审批人解析的统一接口。系统**只读消费**，不维护部门树。MVP 实现为静态 JSON 导入，后续可替换为企业微信/飞书/LDAP。
46	
47	### SchemaVersion（Schema 格式版本）
48	
49	JSONB Schema 根部的 `schemaVersion` 字段（语义版本号，如 `"1.0.0"`）。引擎按版本解释——未知版本拒绝渲染。不同于 `FormTemplate.version`（并发控制，INT）。版本兼容策略：同主版本允许导入，跨主版本拒绝。
50	
51	---
52	
53	## 角色与门户
54	
55	### 角色（Role）
56	
57	系统内**固定的五种角色**，决定用户登录后进入哪个门户、拥有哪些能力。角色由系统预定义（MVP 不动态创建）。
58	
59	枚举：`模板设计者`、`表单填写者`、`审批人`、`系统管理员`、`运维人员`。
60	
61	_Avoid_: 用户组、权限组、岗位
62	
63	### 门户（Portal）
64	
65	按角色分割的独立入口区域。用户登录后按角色路由到对应门户，不同角色看到完全不同的导航结构。
66	
67	五个门户：`/designer`（模板设计者）、`/filler`（表单填写者）、`/approver`（审批人）、`/admin`（系统管理员）、`/ops`（运维人员）。
68	
69	_Avoid_: 后台、控制台、管理端
70	
71	---
72	
73	## 核心操作
74	
75	### 表单提交（Submit）
76	
77	原子操作：在**同一数据库事务**中创建 Instance + 快照 Template + ApprovalRecord。事务后异步投递 Notification + SSE push。
78	
79	### 审批操作（Approve / Reject / Return / Transfer）
80	
81	对当前审批节点的决策。需要 **`Idempotency-Key`**（24 小时窗口）。使用乐观锁（`FormInstance.version`）防止竞态。
82	
83	### 撤回（Withdraw）
84	
85	提交人在审批人未处理时将 Instance 恢复为 `draft`。与审批操作存在竞态窗口，通过乐观锁解决。
86	
87	### 签出 / 签入（Checkout / Checkin）
88	
89	模板编辑的独占锁机制。同一时间仅一人可编辑。管理员可强制解锁。
90	
91	### 条件编辑器（Condition Editor）
92	
93	MVP 仅支持单层 AND 条件（平铺条件行，不支持 OR 和嵌套）。完整嵌套 AND/OR AST 编辑器推迟至 Phase 2。条件数据格式有兼容升级路径——旧格式自动包装为 AndCondition 节点。
94	
95	### 子表单（Subform）
96	
97	可增删行的表格/结构化数据。最大嵌套深度 2 层（主表单 → 子表单 → 孙表单）。子表单内字段支持条件联动和验证。
98	
99	---
100	
101	## 并发控制
102	
103	### 乐观锁（Optimistic Locking）
104	
105	`FormInstance` 和 `FormTemplate` 使用 `version` 列（整数，从 1 开始）。UPDATE 时 WHERE 条件包含 `version = :expected`，并 `SET version = version + 1`。0 rows affected → 冲突 → 返回 409。
106	
107	适用于：撤回 vs 审批竞态、重复提交、并发保存。
108	
109	### 幂等键（Idempotency Key）
110	
111	写操作客户端生成唯一 key，服务端存储 key → response。24 小时后可回收。重复请求返回缓存结果，不重复执行。
112	
113	---
114	
115	## 事务
116	
117	### 事务边界（Transaction Boundary）
118	
119	数据库事务保护 Instance + Snapshot + ApprovalRecord 的原子写入。事务外（异步）：Notification 持久化 + SSE push。审批人解析在事务内执行——失败回滚整个提交。
120	
121	---
122	
123	## 关联文档
124	
125	- [设计系统](docs/design-system-form-engine.md) —— 设计 token 词汇表与门户壳（chrome）规格（实现细节，不在本词汇表内）
126	- [Sitemap](docs/sitemap-form-engine.md) —— 门户路由模型（5 角色门户）
127	
128	---
129	
130	> **维护规则**：术语更新随领域建模讨论即时修改。本文件不含实现细节（框架、数据库、API 路径）。
131
```
</details></tool-use>

1	import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
2	import { config } from "../config";
3	
4	const MUTATING_METHODS = ["POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"];
5	
6	/**
7	 * CSRF protection middleware.
8	 *
9	 * For all mutating requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), validates that the
10	 * X-CSRF-Token header matches the CSRF cookie value.
11	 *
12	 * The CSRF cookie is set by the client (readable via non-httpOnly cookie)
13	 * and sent back in the X-CSRF-Token header.
14	 *
15	 * MVP implementation: validates token presence and cookie presence.
16	 * Full implementation would set the cookie server-side on login.
17	 */
18	export function csrfMiddleware(
19	  req: Request,
20	  res: Response,
21	  next: NextFunction
22	): void {
23	  // Skip CSRF check for non-mutating methods
24	  if (!MUTATING_METHODS.includes(req.method)) {
25	    return next();
26	  }
27	
28	  // Skip CSRF for health check
29	  if (req.path === "/api/v1/health") {
30	    return next();
31	  }
32	
33	  const csrfCookie = req.cookies?.[config.csrf.cookieName];
34	  const csrfHeader = req.headers["x-csrf-token"] as string | undefined;
35	
36	  // In MVP, if CSRF cookie is not set yet, allow the request
37	  // The CSRF cookie will be set by the auth service on login.
38	  // In production, this should reject requests without a valid CSRF token.
39	  if (!csrfCookie) {
40	    // Log warning in non-production environments
41	    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
42	      console.warn(
43	        `[CSRF] No CSRF cookie found — allowing request to ${req.method} ${req.path} (MVP mode)`
44	      );
45	    }
46	    return next();
47	  }
48	
49	  if (!csrfHeader) {
50	    res.status(403).json({
51	      error: {
52	        code: "CSRF_TOKEN_MISSING",
53	        message: "缺少 CSRF Token，请刷新页面后重试",
54	      },
55	    });
56	    return;
57	  }
58	
59	  if (csrfCookie !== csrfHeader) {
60	    res.status(403).json({
61	      error: {
62	        code: "CSRF_TOKEN_MISMATCH",
63	        message: "CSRF Token 不匹配，请刷新页面后重试",
64	      },
65	    });
66	    return;
67	  }
68	
69	  next();
70	}
71

```text
1	# 实施规格说明书：动态表单引擎 MVP
2	
3	> 版本：v1.0
4	> 日期：2026-08-12
5	> 状态：就绪（ready-for-agent）
6	> 来源：基于 [设计规格 v1.2](design-spec-form-engine.md) + 6 项 ADR + C1-C14 整改决策
7	
8	---
9	
10	## Problem Statement
11	
12	企业业务系统中，每个表单需要独立开发前端代码。中等复杂度表单开发 2-3 天，需求变更时修改成本高，各表单样式和交互难以统一。业务人员无技术能力自主创建表单，完全依赖开发团队。
13	
14	本系统解决的核心问题：**让业务人员零代码创建表单、配置审批流程；员工在统一界面完成填写与审批追踪。**
15	
16	目标规模：50 并发在线填写者，日均 100 次提交。
17	
18	---
19	
20	## Solution
21	
22	一个**配置驱动的动态表单引擎**，采用 Schema → Engine → Component 三层架构：
23	
24	```
25	表单设计者编排 Schema（JSON 配置）
26	        ↓
27	引擎解析 Schema，驱动渲染、验证、联动、审批流转
28	        ↓
29	填写者看到统一 UI，审批人通过内置工作流处理
30	```
31	
32	**MVP 技术栈**：React 18 + Vite（前端），Express + PostgreSQL + JSONB（后端），SSE（实时通知），Docker Compose 部署。
33	
34	---
35	
36	## User Stories
37	
38	### 表单设计者
39	
40	1. As a 表单设计者, I want to 创建空白表单模板并设置名称、描述和分类, so that 建立表单元数据基础。
41	2. As a 表单设计者, I want to 从组件面板拖拽字段到画布并自由调整顺序, so that 可视化编排表单结构。
42	3. As a 表单设计者, I want to 选中字段后在属性面板配置标签、提示文本、默认值和验证规则, so that 精确控制字段行为。
43	4. As a 表单设计者, I want to 创建章节（字段分组）并支持折叠/展开, so that 组织复杂表单的布局层次。
44	5. As a 表单设计者, I want to 为字段配置单层 AND 显示条件（如"设备类型=研发 → 显示某字段"）, so that 根据上下文动态控制表单。
45	6. As a 表单设计者, I want to 在设计器右侧面板实时预览填写态效果, so that 即时验证设计效果。
46	7. As a 表单设计者, I want to 签出表单模板获得独占编辑权，完成后签入, so that 防止多人并发编辑冲突。
47	8. As a 表单设计者, I want to 将表单配置导出为可迁移文件并导入到其他环境, so that 通过 DEV→SIT→UAT→PROD 逐级验证后上线。
48	9. As a 表单设计者, I want to 为表单配置多级审批链（组织架构/角色/指定人员）, so that 提交后自动触发审批流转。
49	
50	### 表单填写者
51	
52	10. As a 填写者, I want to 浏览我有权限的已发布表单列表并支持搜索和分类筛选, so that 快速找到目标表单。
53	11. As a 填写者, I want to 按照设计者编排的结构依次填写字段, so that 完成信息录入。
54	12. As a 填写者, I want to 填写时实时看到字段验证反馈（必填未填、格式不符）, so that 提交前修正错误。
55	13. As a 填写者, I want to 将未完成的表单保存为草稿并稍后恢复继续填写, so that 不丢失已输入内容。
56	14. As a 填写者, I want to 草稿自动保存（失焦 + 30s 兜底）, so that 即使忘记手动保存数据也不丢失。
57	15. As a 填写者, I want to 打开草稿时被告知模板是否已更新且已有数据尽力匹配, so that 知道字段变化且数据不丢失。
58	16. As a 填写者, I want to 提交表单后在同一界面看到审批链状态（各级审批人、当前进度）, so that 了解流转进展。
59	17. As a 填写者, I want to 在审批人未处理时撤回已提交的表单, so that 修正错误后重新提交。
60	18. As a 填写者, I want to 在移动端浏览器中完整完成填写、提交和进度查看, so that 在手机和平板上工作。
61	
62	### 审批人
63	
64	19. As a 审批人, I want to 收到新审批请求的通知并一键进入审批界面, so that 及时处理。
65	20. As a 审批人, I want to 在审批界面同时看到完整表单内容（只读）和审批链状态, so that 充分了解上下文后决策。
66	21. As a 审批人, I want to 点击"同意"使审批流转至下一级或完成, so that 推进流程。
67	22. As a 审批人, I want to 点击"拒绝"并填写原因使流程终止, so that 否决不合规的提交。
68	23. As a 审批人, I want to 将表单退回给提交人要求修改, so that 补正不完整或错误信息。
69	24. As a 审批人, I want to 将审批转交给另一位指定人员, so that 在自身无法处理时分流。
70	25. As a 审批人, I want to 看到审批链上所有参与者的审批状态和意见, so that 了解完整审批上下文。
71	
72	### 数据管理者
73	
74	26. As a 被授权用户, I want to 按表单类型查看所有已提交的数据列表并支持筛选, so that 检索历史记录。
75	27. As a 被授权用户, I want to 查看单条提交的完整表单内容和审批历史, so that 了解详情。
76	28. As a 被授权用户, I want to 将筛选数据导出为 Excel, so that 用于离线分析或对接其他系统。
77	29. As a 被授权用户, I want to 查看按表单类型的提交量统计, so that 了解各表单使用情况。
78	
79	### 系统管理员
80	
81	30. As a 管理员, I want to 创建自定义角色并分配能力, so that 权限模型匹配组织实际职能。
82	31. As a 管理员, I want to 将角色分配给用户, so that 用户获得对应操作权限。
83	32. As a 管理员, I want to 在特殊情况下强制签入被锁定的模板, so that 解除异常锁定。
84	
85	---
86	
87	## Seams
88	
89	测试应围绕以下模块边界（从内到外）：
90	
91	### 一级 Seam：FormEngine 纯逻辑（推荐主要测试点）
92	
93	这些模块零外部依赖——无 DOM、无数据库、无网络。纯函数/状态机，单元测试成本最低、价值最高：
94	
95	- **SchemaParser**：Raw JSON → ParsedSchema IR。校验结构合法性、字段类型可识别、审批链完整性、子表单嵌套深度 ≤ 2。
96	- **ValidationEngine**：`validateField(fieldSchema, value) → FieldError[]`、`validateAll(parsedSchema, values) → AllErrors`。覆盖每种验证规则独立执行和组合执行。
97	- **ConditionEvaluator**：`evaluate(conditionNode, allValues) → boolean`。MVP 仅 AND 组合；每种运算符全覆盖。
98	- **VisibilityEngine**：基于当前 values 计算 fields/sections 可见性。单字段联动、章节级联动、依赖链重算。
99	- **FormStateManager**：reducer——`dispatch(action) → new State`。setValue 触发联动+验证；touched 追踪；dirty 标记。
100	- **ApprovalStateMachine**：`transition(currentState, action) → newState`。覆盖 7 个状态、6 种转换、合法与非法路径。基于属性测试生成随机序列验证不变量。
101	- **ApprovalResolver**：`resolveApprover(rule, submitter) → approver`。3 种规则类型；解析失败返回 null。
102	
103	### 二级 Seam：API 端点
104	
105	Express route handler——HTTP 请求 → 响应。可用 supertest + 测试数据库：
106	
107	- 模板 CRUD、签出/签入、发布、导出/导入
108	- 实例提交（原子事务校验、模板状态校验）、草稿保存/恢复、撤回
109	- 审批操作（幂等、乐观锁冲突 409、状态机守卫）
110	- 通知列表、标记已读
111	
112	### 三级 Seam：组件渲染
113	
114	React Testing Library + 模拟 FormEngine：
115	
116	- 字段组件按 FieldComponentProps 契约正确渲染
117	- 表单提交按钮 disabled 状态、防重点击
118	- 草稿自动保存状态指示器
119	
120	### 端到端
121	
122	4 条关键旅程（Cypress/Playwright）：
123	
124	1. 设计者创建模板 → 拖拽字段 → 配置属性 → 配置审批链 → 发布 → 导出
125	2. 填写者浏览 → 打开表单 → 填写 → 保存草稿 → 恢复草稿 → 提交 → 查看审批进度
126	3. 审批人收到通知 → 查看待审批 → 审批同意/拒绝/退回/转交 → 流程完成
127	4. 移动端浏览器打开 → 表单适配单列 → 填写 → 提交
128	
129	---
130	
131	## Implementation Decisions
132	
133	### 数据完整性
134	
135	**ID-01：混合事务策略**。表单提交和审批操作的核心写入（Instance + Snapshot + ApprovalRecord）在同一个数据库事务中执行。事务提交后异步投递 Notification 持久化和 SSE push。审批人解析在事务内执行，失败回滚整个提交。详见 [ADR-0001](adr/0001-transaction-boundaries.md)。
136	
137	**ID-02：审批接口幂等键**。`approve`、`reject`、`return`、`transfer` 四个接口强制 `Idempotency-Key` Header。24 小时幂等窗口。`submit` 不强制——前端防抖 + 乐观锁兜底。详见 [ADR-0002](adr/0002-idempotency-keys.md)。
138	
139	### 并发控制
140	
141	**ID-03：乐观锁**。`FormInstance` 和 `FormTemplate` 增加 `version` INT 列（从 1 开始）。UPDATE 的 WHERE 条件包含 `version = :expected`，SET `version = version + 1`。0 rows affected → 409 Conflict。撤回与审批竞态、重复提交均通过此机制消除。前端收到 409 后显示明确提示（"该提交已被撤回"）并自动刷新。详见 [ADR-0003](adr/0003-optimistic-locking.md)。
142	
143	### 版本化
144	
145	**ID-04：API 版本前缀**。所有路由使用 `/api/v1/`。前端在统一位置配置 base URL。
146	
147	**ID-05：Schema 格式版本**。每个 JSONB Schema 根部必含 `schemaVersion` 字段（语义版本号，如 `"1.0.0"`）。引擎按版本解释，未知版本拒绝渲染。导出兼容策略：同主版本允许，跨主版本拒绝 + 手动迁移脚本。注意区分 `FormTemplate.version`（并发控制 INT）和 `schema.schemaVersion`（格式版本 string）。详见 [ADR-0005](adr/0005-schema-api-versioning.md)。
148	
149	### 草稿与数据
150	
151	**ID-06：草稿-模板版本不匹配**。打开草稿时比较 `draft.updatedAt` 与 `FormTemplate.updatedAt`。基于 fieldId 尽力映射——匹配的自动迁移，不匹配的移入 `_orphaned` 对象。界面顶部黄色提示条。详见 [ADR-0004](adr/0004-draft-template-version-mismatch.md)。
152	
153	**ID-07：草稿自动保存**。onBlur 触发（dirty 检测）+ 30s 定时兜底。无变更不请求。界面显示"草稿已保存 X 秒前"。
154	
155	**ID-08：提交时校验模板状态**。`POST /api/v1/instances/:id/submit` 必须确认 `template.status === 'published'`，否则拒绝提交。
156	
157	### MVP 范围约束
158	
159	**ID-09：条件编辑器 MVP**。仅支持单层 AND 条件（平铺条件行，不支持 OR 和嵌套分组）。数据格式预留升级路径——Phase 2 时旧格式自动包装为 AndCondition 节点。详见 [ADR-0006](adr/0006-mvp-condition-editor-scope.md)。
160	
161	**ID-10：子表单深度**。最大嵌套 2 层（主表单 → 子表单 → 孙表单）。SchemaParser 校验拒绝更深嵌套。子表单内字段支持联动和验证。
162	
163	**ID-11：模板无审批流程**。模板状态仅 `draft` / `published` / `archived`。设计者可直接发布。质量保障通过 UAT → PROD 环境晋升实现。
164	
165	### 组织架构与通知
166	
167	**ID-12：组织架构只读消费**。系统不维护部门树。通过 `OrgDataSource` 接口抽象（`getUser`、`searchUsers`、`getUserManager`），MVP 实现为静态 JSON 导入。UserPicker 和审批人解析通过该接口获取数据。后续可替换为企业微信/飞书/LDAP。
168	
169	**ID-13：通知渠道适配器**。MVP 仅站内通知（SSE 实时 + 通知中心持久化）。NotificationService 投递层使用适配器模式——`InAppChannel`（默认），后续可插拔 Email、企微等渠道。
170	
171	### 安全
172	
173	**ID-14：CSRF 防护**。`httpOnly` Cookie 存储 JWT + `X-CSRF-Token` Header（值从独立非 httpOnly Cookie 读取）。所有非 GET 请求校验收 Token。
174	
175	**ID-15：速率限制**。Express 中间件 + 内存计数：登录 5/min/IP、文件上传 20/min/用户、提交 10/min/用户、导出 5/hour/用户。
176	
177	**ID-16：文件名消毒**。上传时丢弃原始路径，保留 basename，前加 UUID 前缀。存储路径必须在 `upload_root` 内验证通过。格式：`{upload_dir}/{uuid}_{sanitized_basename}`。
178	
179	### 跨领域决策
180	
181	**ID-17**：单租户（无 `tenant_id`）、仅中文（MVP）、结构化日志（Pino/Winston JSON + traceId）、Docker Compose 部署、进程内事件队列（MVP）、Knex 迁移、JWT 滑动过期（7 天 + `/api/v1/auth/refresh`）、统一错误格式 `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`、偏移量分页（page/pageSize，上限 100）、环境变量 + dotenv。
182	
183	### 错误码
184	
185	```
186	VALIDATION_ERROR          → 422  字段值校验失败
187	VERSION_CONFLICT          → 409  乐观锁冲突
188	IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT      → 409  幂等键重复（不同请求体）
189	TEMPLATE_LOCKED           → 409  模板已被他人签出
190	TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED    → 400  模板未发布或已下线
191	APPROVAL_NOT_PENDING      → 400  审批已处理，无法操作
192	APPROVER_RESOLUTION_FAILED → 500  审批人解析失败
193	SCHEMA_VERSION_UNKNOWN    → 400  Schema 版本不被引擎支持
194	RATE_LIMITED              → 429  触发速率限制
195	```
196	
197	---
198	
199	## Testing Decisions
200	
201	### 什么构成好的测试
202	
203	- 测试**外部行为**，不测试内部实现。验证给定输入 → 输出/副作用，不验证内部调用链。
204	- 一级 Seam 优先——纯逻辑模块用单元测试全覆盖。每个模块的错误路径必须至少和快乐路径一样多的测试分量。
205	- 集成测试覆盖 API 端点 + 数据库交互——重点验证事务边界和并发行为。
206	- E2E 仅覆盖 4 条关键旅程——不做边界用例的 E2E（成本高、运行慢）。
207	
208	### 关键测试场景
209	
210	**单元测试（Engine 模块）**：
211	
212	| 模块 | 必须覆盖 |
213	|------|---------|
214	| SchemaParser | 合法 Schema 解析；缺少必填字段/未知 fieldType/空审批链/嵌套超深的拒绝；子表单深度边界（2 层通过，3 层拒绝） |
215	| ValidationEngine | 每种验证规则独立执行；组合规则执行；跨字段验证（如日期比较）；空值和边界值 |
216	| ConditionEvaluator | 每个运算符全覆盖；AND 短路求值；字段不存在/值为 null 的防御 |
217	| VisibilityEngine | 单字段联动；章节级联动；多字段依赖链；条件从 true→false 时子字段也隐藏 |
218	| FormStateManager | setValue 触发验证和联动；touched 仅在 onBlur 时 true；dirty 标记；reset/restore |
219	| ApprovalStateMachine | 合法转换执行；非法转换拒绝（如 approved→withdraw）；基于属性的测试——生成随机合法/非法序列，验证不变量（终态不可转变、每个状态可到达） |
220	| ApprovalResolver | org_structure/role/specific 三个规则；解析失败返回 null；解析结果正确映射到 User |
221	
222	**集成测试**：
223	
224	- 表单提交：原子写入验证（Instance + Snapshot + ApprovalRecord 要么全有要么全无）
225	- 提交时模板已下线 → 400
226	- 审批操作 + 幂等键：重复请求返回缓存结果
227	- 审批 + 乐观锁：version 不匹配返回 409
228	- 撤回 + 乐观锁：审批人已处理后撤回返回 409
229	- 草稿版本不匹配：打开时检测并正确生成 _orphaned
230	- 文件上传路径穿越：恶意文件名被消毒
231	
232	**审批状态机属性测试（示例）**：
233	
234	```
235	Given 状态机从 DRAFT 开始
236	When  生成随机合法动作序列
237	Then  验证不变量——
238	     - 终态（APPROVED, REJECTED）不可再 transition
239	     - WITHDRAWN 后状态回到 DRAFT
240	     - RETURNED 后重新 SUBMIT 从第一节点开始
241	Given 状态机在任意状态
242	When  生成随机非法动作
243	Then  全部被拒绝，状态不变
244	```
245	
246	### E2E 旅程
247	
248	仅 4 条，不增不减。每条覆盖一个完整的用户角色视角。
249	
250	---
251	
252	## Out of Scope
253	
254	以下明确为 MVP 不做：
255	
256	- **嵌套 AND/OR 条件编辑器**（Phase 2）
257	- **邮件/短信/企业微信通知渠道**（架构预留适配器接口，实现推迟）
258	- **移动端离线填写**（依赖 Service Worker）
259	- **可视化统计仪表板**（仅提供按模板类型计数）
260	- **多租户隔离**（企业内部单租户部署）
261	- **国际化/多语言**（仅中文）
262	- **React Query / 独立缓存层**（MVP 用自定义 hook + fetch）
263	- **Zustand 全局状态**（MVP 统一用 Context + useReducer）
264	- **独立任务队列（Redis/Bull）**（MVP 用进程内事件队列）
265	- **审批意见可见性粒度控制**（MVP 所有参与者可见）
266	- **审批超时自动处理**（人工跟进，无自动超时）
267	- **大于 1000 条的异步 Excel 导出**（MVP 同步导出限 1000 条）
268

1	import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
2	import type { Dispatch } from "react";
3	import type {
4	  FieldSchema,
5	  FormAction,
6	  FormState,
7	  ParsedSchema,
8	} from "form-engine-core";
9	import { FormRenderContext } from "./context";
10	import { Section } from "./fields/Section";
11	import { definitionKey, getValueAtPath, setValueAtPath } from "./paths";
12	import { ComponentFactory } from "./registry";
13	
14	export interface FormRendererProps {
15	  schema: ParsedSchema;
16	  state: FormState;
17	  dispatch: Dispatch<FormAction>;
18	}
19	
20	/**
21	 * FormRenderer — recursively renders a parsed schema: visible sections → visible
22	 * fields → (for subforms) row-indexed child fields. Subform children are edited
23	 * by rewriting their top-level array and dispatching SET_VALUE on the top-level
24	 * field, which keeps the engine's targeted revalidation intact.
25	 */
26	export function FormRenderer({ schema, state, dispatch }: FormRendererProps) {
27	  const renderField = useCallback(
28	    (field: FieldSchema, path: string): React.ReactNode => {
29	      // Visibility is per *definition* (no row index), unlike errors/values.
30	      if (state.visibility[definitionKey(path)] === false) return null;
31	
32	      const value = getValueAtPath(state.values, path);
33	      const rootId = path.split(".")[0];
34	
35	      return (
36	        <ComponentFactory
37	          key={path}
38	          field={field}
39	          id={path}
40	          value={value}
41	          error={state.errors[path]}
42	          disabled={state.disabled[path] === true}
43	          onChange={(next) => {
44	            const values = setValueAtPath(state.values, path, next);
45	            dispatch({ type: "SET_VALUE", fieldId: rootId, value: values[rootId] });
46	          }}
47	          onBlur={() => dispatch({ type: "BLUR", fieldId: rootId })}
48	        />
49	      );
50	    },
51	    [state, dispatch],
52	  );
53	
54	  const contextValue = useMemo(
55	    () => ({ state, dispatch, renderField }),
56	    [state, dispatch, renderField],
57	  );
58	
59	  return (
60	    <FormRenderContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
61	      {schema.sections.map((section) => {
62	        if (state.visibility[section.id] === false) return null;
63	        return (
64	          <Section key={section.id} section={section}>
65	            {section.fields.map((field) => renderField(field, field.id))}
66	          </Section>
67	        );
68	      })}
69	    </FormRenderContext.Provider>
70	  );
71	}
72
```
</details></tool-use>

1	import { useCallback, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";
2	import type { Reducer } from "react";
3	import {
4	  createFormReducer,
5	  createInitialState,
6	} from "form-engine-core";
7	import type {
8	  FormAction,
9	  FormState,
10	  FormValues,
11	  ParsedSchema,
12	} from "form-engine-core";
13	
14	/**
15	 * React binding for the engine's FormStateManager reducer. Exposes the live
16	 * `FormState` plus small convenience dispatchers so callers rarely touch raw
17	 * actions.
18	 */
19	export function useForm(schema: ParsedSchema, initialValues: FormValues = {}) {
20	  const reducer = useMemo(
21	    () => createFormReducer(schema, initialValues),
22	    [schema, initialValues],
23	  );
24	
25	  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
26	    reducer as Reducer<FormState, FormAction>,
27	    createInitialState(schema, initialValues),
28	  );
29	
30	  const setValue = useCallback(
31	    (fieldId: string, value: unknown) =>
32	      dispatch({ type: "SET_VALUE", fieldId, value }),
33	    [],
34	  );
35	
36	  const blur = useCallback(
37	    (fieldId: string) => dispatch({ type: "BLUR", fieldId }),
38	    [],
39	  );
40	
41	  const setSubmitting = useCallback(
42	    (submitting: boolean) => dispatch({ type: "SET_SUBMITTING", submitting }),
43	    [],
44	  );
45	
46	  const validateAll = useCallback(
47	    () => dispatch({ type: "VALIDATE_ALL" }),
48	    [],
49	  );
50	
51	  return { state, dispatch, setValue, blur, setSubmitting, validateAll };
52	}
53

1	import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
2	import {
3	  validateAll,
4	} from "form-engine-core";
5	import type {
6	  AllErrors,
7	  FormValues,
8	  OrgDataSource,
9	  ParsedSchema,
10	} from "form-engine-core";
11	import { FormEngineContext } from "./context";
12	import { FormRenderer } from "./FormRenderer";
13	import "./form.css";
14	import { definitionKey } from "./paths";
15	import { useForm } from "./useForm";
16	
17	function isVisibleErrorKey(
18	  key: string,
19	  visibility: Record<string, boolean>,
20	): boolean {
21	  return visibility[definitionKey(key)] !== false;
22	}
23	
24	function firstVisibleErrorKey(
25	  errors: AllErrors,
26	  visibility: Record<string, boolean>,
27	): string | null {
28	  for (const [key, errs] of Object.entries(errors)) {
29	    if (errs.length > 0 && isVisibleErrorKey(key, visibility)) return key;
30	  }
31	  return null;
32	}
33	
34	function scrollToField(fieldId: string): void {
35	  // Leaf inputs carry `id`, but radio/checkbox groups, subforms and info text
36	  // only expose `data-field-id` (or the native group `name`). Fall back so
37	  // form-level validation can reach any field type.
38	  const element =
39	    document.getElementById(fieldId) ??
40	    document.querySelector(`[data-field-id="${fieldId}"]`) ??
41	    document.querySelector(`[name="${fieldId}"]`);
42	  if (!element) return;
43	  element.scrollIntoView?.({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
44	  (element as HTMLElement).focus?.();
45	}
46	
47	export interface FormProps {
48	  schema: ParsedSchema;
49	  initialValues?: FormValues;
50	  onSubmit?: (values: FormValues) => void | Promise<void>;
51	  orgDataSource?: OrgDataSource | null;
52	  submitLabel?: string;
53	}
54	
55	/**
56	 * Form — the top-level filling surface. Wires the engine reducer to the
57	 * renderer, provides the org data source, and owns submission:
58	 *
59	 *  - the submit button is hard-disabled only while `submitting` (preventing
60	 *    double submits); while the form is invalid it stays clickable so a click
61	 *    triggers form-level validation + scroll-to-first-error instead of
62	 *    submitting — submission stays gated until every visible field passes. The
63	 *    invalid styling + hint surface only after a submit attempt, so a pristine
64	 *    form doesn't warn about untouched required fields.
65	 */
66	export function Form({
67	  schema,
68	  initialValues = {},
69	  onSubmit,
70	  orgDataSource = null,
71	  submitLabel = "提交",
72	}: FormProps) {
73	  const { state, dispatch, setSubmitting } = useForm(schema, initialValues);
74	  const [attempted, setAttempted] = useState(false);
75	
76	  const hasErrors = useMemo(() => {
77	    const errors = validateAll(schema, state.values);
78	    return firstVisibleErrorKey(errors, state.visibility) !== null;
79	  }, [schema, state.values, state.visibility]);
80	
81	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
82	    const errors = validateAll(schema, state.values);
83	    const firstKey = firstVisibleErrorKey(errors, state.visibility);
84	    if (firstKey !== null) {
85	      // Surface the failures in the UI (visibility-filtered) and jump to the first.
86	      setAttempted(true);
87	      dispatch({ type: "VALIDATE_ALL" });
88	      scrollToField(firstKey);
89	      return;
90	    }
91	
92	    setSubmitting(true);
93	    try {
94	      await onSubmit?.(state.values);
95	    } finally {
96	      setSubmitting(false);
97	    }
98	  };
99	
100	  return (
101	    <FormEngineContext.Provider value={{ orgDataSource }}>
102	      <form className="form-engine" noValidate>
103	        <FormRenderer schema={schema} state={state} dispatch={dispatch} />
104	        <div className="form-actions">
105	          <button
106	            type="button"
107	            className={
108	              attempted && hasErrors
109	                ? "form-submit form-submit--invalid"
110	                : "form-submit"
111	            }
112	            disabled={state.submitting}
113	            onClick={() => void handleSubmit()}
114	          >
115	            {state.submitting ? "提交中…" : submitLabel}
116	          </button>
117	          {attempted && hasErrors && !state.submitting && (
118	            <p className="form-submit-hint">请先完成所有必填项</p>
119	          )}
120	        </div>
121	      </form>
122	    </FormEngineContext.Provider>
123	  );
124	}

17	/** fieldType → Component. Extending the engine = registering a new entry here. */
18	export const ComponentRegistry: Record<FieldType, FieldComponent> = {
19	  text: TextInput,
20	  textarea: TextArea,
21	  number: NumberInput,
22	  select: Select,
23	  radio: RadioGroup,
24	  checkbox: CheckboxGroup,
25	  date: DatePicker,
26	  datetime: DateTimePicker,
27	  file: FileUpload,
28	  subform: SubForm,
29	  "user-picker": UserPicker,
30	  section: SectionField,
31	  "info-text": InfoText,
32	};
33	
34	export interface ComponentFactoryProps {
35	  field: FieldSchema;
36	  id: string;
37	  value: unknown;
38	  error?: FieldError[];
39	  disabled: boolean;
40	  onChange: (value: unknown) => void;
41	  onBlur: () => void;
42	}
43	
44	/**
45	 * ComponentFactory — instantiates the component for a field and injects the
46	 * uniform FieldComponentProps contract (design spec §2.1.5). Convenience props
47	 * (`label`, `placeholder`, `options`, `validation`) are read from the schema.
48	 */
49	export function ComponentFactory({
50	  field,
51	  id,
52	  value,
53	  error,
54	  disabled,
55	  onChange,
56	  onBlur,
57	}: ComponentFactoryProps): React.ReactElement {
58	  const Component = ComponentRegistry[field.type];
59	  if (!Component) {
60	    throw new Error(`No component registered for field type "${field.type}"`);
61	  }
62	
63	  const props: FieldComponentProps = {
64	    id,
65	    label: field.label,
66	    value,
67	    onChange,
68	    onBlur,
69	    error,
70	    disabled,
71	    placeholder: field.placeholder,
72	    options: field.options,
73	    validation: field.validation,
74	    schema: field,
75	  };
76	
77	  return <Component {...props} />;
78	}

1	/**
2	 * SchemaParser — validates raw JSON and produces a typed ParsedSchema IR.
3	 *
4	 * Validation performed (per issue 02):
5	 *  - `schemaVersion` must be present and supported (major version 1)
6	 *  - schema structure must be legal (sections[] of valid sections/fields)
7	 *  - every `fieldType` must be recognizable
8	 *  - subform nesting depth ≤ 2 (a subform inside a grand-child subform is rejected)
9	 *  - approval chain (when supplied) must be complete and well-formed
10	 *
11	 * Rejections throw a typed {@link SchemaParseError} with a machine-readable code.
12	 */
13	
14	import {
15	  CONDITION_OPERATORS,
16	  FIELD_TYPES,
17	  VALIDATION_RULE_TYPES,
18	  type ApprovalChain,
19	  type ApprovalNode,
20	  type ApproverRule,
21	  type ConditionNode,
22	  type ConditionOperator,
23	  type FieldSchema,
24	  type FieldType,
25	  type FieldValidation,
26	  type ParsedSchema,
27	  type SectionSchema,
28	  type ValidationRule,
29	} from "./types";
30	
31	export type SchemaParseErrorCode =
32	  | "SCHEMA_VERSION_MISSING"
33	  | "SCHEMA_VERSION_UNKNOWN"
34	  | "SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID"
35	  | "FIELD_TYPE_UNKNOWN"
36	  | "SUBFORM_NESTING_TOO_DEEP"
37	  | "APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID";
38	
39	export class SchemaParseError extends Error {
40	  readonly code: SchemaParseErrorCode;
41	  readonly path: string;
42	
43	  constructor(code: SchemaParseErrorCode, message: string, path = "$") {
44	    super(`${message} (at ${path})`);
45	    this.name = "SchemaParseError";
46	    this.code = code;
47	    this.path = path;
48	  }
49	}
50	
51	/** Maximum nesting depth for subforms (主表单 → 子表单 → 孙表单 = 2 levels). */
52	export const MAX_SUBFORM_DEPTH = 2;
53	
54	/** Supported schema major version (see ADR-0005: same-major accepted). */
55	export const SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_MAJOR = "1";
56	
57	function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
58	  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
59	}
60	
61	function isSupportedSchemaVersion(version: string): boolean {
62	  const major = version.split(".")[0];
63	  return major === SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_MAJOR;
64	}
65	
66	function requireString(
67	  value: unknown,
68	  path: string,
69	  what: string,
70	): string {
71	  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.trim() === "") {
72	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", `${what} must be a non-empty string`, path);
73	  }
74	  return value;
75	}
76	
77	function optionalString(value: unknown, path: string, what: string): string | undefined {
78	  if (value === undefined || value === null) return undefined;
79	  if (typeof value !== "string") {
80	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", `${what} must be a string`, path);
81	  }
82	  return value;
83	}
84	
85	function optionalBoolean(value: unknown, path: string, what: string): boolean {
86	  if (value === undefined || value === null) return false;
87	  if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
88	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", `${what} must be a boolean`, path);
89	  }
90	  return value;
91	}
92	
93	// ── Conditions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
94	
95	function parseCondition(value: unknown, path: string): ConditionNode {
96	  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
97	    // A bare array is an implicit AND group.
98	    return {
99	      conditions: value.map((c, i) => parseCondition(c, `${path}[${i}]`)),
100	    };
101	  }
102	  if (!isObject(value)) {
103	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "visibilityCondition must be an object or array", path);
104	  }
105	
106	  if (Array.isArray(value.conditions)) {
107	    const type = value.type;
108	    if (type !== undefined && type !== "and") {
109	      throw new SchemaParseError(
110	        "SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID",
111	        `condition group type "${String(type)}" is not supported in the MVP`,
112	        path,
113	      );
114	    }
115	    return {
116	      ...(type === "and" ? { type: "and" as const } : {}),
117	      conditions: (value.conditions as unknown[]).map((c, i) => parseCondition(c, `${path}.conditions[${i}]`)),
118	    };
119	  }
120	
121	  if (typeof value.fieldId !== "string" || value.fieldId === "") {
122	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "condition must have a string fieldId", path);
123	  }
124	  if (typeof value.operator !== "string" || !(CONDITION_OPERATORS as readonly string[]).includes(value.operator)) {
125	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", `unknown condition operator "${String(value.operator)}"`, path);
126	  }
127	  return {
128	    fieldId: value.fieldId,
129	    operator: value.operator as ConditionOperator,
130	    ...(value.value !== undefined ? { value: value.value } : {}),
131	  };
132	}
133	
134	function parseVisibilityCondition(value: unknown, path: string): ConditionNode | null | undefined {
135	  if (value === undefined || value === null) return null;
136	  return parseCondition(value, path);
137	}
138	
139	// ── Validation rules ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
140	
141	function parseValidationRules(value: unknown, path: string): FieldValidation | undefined {
142	  if (value === undefined || value === null) return undefined;
143	  if (!isObject(value)) {
144	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "validation must be an object", path);
145	  }
146	  const rules = value.rules;
147	  if (rules === undefined || rules === null) return undefined;
148	  if (!Array.isArray(rules)) {
149	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "validation.rules must be an array", path);
150	  }
151	  return {
152	    rules: rules.map((r, i) => {
153	      if (!isObject(r)) {
154	        throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "validation rule must be an object", `${path}.rules[${i}]`);
155	      }
156	      const type = r.type;
157	      if (typeof type !== "string" || !(VALIDATION_RULE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type)) {
158	        throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", `unknown validation rule type "${String(type)}"`, `${path}.rules[${i}]`);
159	      }
160	      const rule: ValidationRule = { type: type as ValidationRule["type"] };
161	      if (r.value !== undefined) rule.value = r.value;
162	      if (r.message !== undefined) rule.message = optionalString(r.message, `${path}.rules[${i}]`, "message");
163	      if (r.fieldId !== undefined) rule.fieldId = optionalString(r.fieldId, `${path}.rules[${i}]`, "fieldId");
164	      if (r.operator !== undefined) {
165	        const op = optionalString(r.operator, `${path}.rules[${i}]`, "operator");
166	        if (op && (CONDITION_OPERATORS as readonly string[]).includes(op)) {
167	          rule.operator = op as ValidationRule["operator"];
168	        }
169	      }
170	      return rule;
171	    }),
172	  };
173	}
174	
175	// ── Fields ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
176	
177	function parseField(value: unknown, path: string, depth: number): FieldSchema {
178	  if (!isObject(value)) {
179	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "field must be an object", path);
180	  }
181	
182	  const id = requireString(value.id, path, "field.id");
183	  const type = requireString(value.type, path, "field.type");
184	  if (!(FIELD_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type)) {
185	    throw new SchemaParseError("FIELD_TYPE_UNKNOWN", `unknown fieldType "${type}"`, path);
186	  }
187	  const label = requireString(value.label, path, "field.label");
188	
189	  const field: FieldSchema = {
190	    id,
191	    type: type as FieldType,
192	    label,
193	    required: optionalBoolean(value.required, path, "field.required"),
194	  };
195	
196	  field.placeholder = optionalString(value.placeholder, path, "placeholder");
197	  field.helpText = optionalString(value.helpText, path, "helpText");
198	  field.defaultValue = value.defaultValue;
199	
200	  if (value.options !== undefined && value.options !== null) {
201	    if (!Array.isArray(value.options)) {
202	      throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "field.options must be an array", path);
203	    }
204	    field.options = value.options.map((o, i) => {
205	      if (!isObject(o) || typeof o.label !== "string" || typeof o.value !== "string") {
206	        throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "option must have string label and value", `${path}.options[${i}]`);
207	      }
208	      return { label: o.label, value: o.value };
209	    });
210	  }
211	
212	  field.validation = parseValidationRules(value.validation, path);
213	  field.visibilityCondition = parseVisibilityCondition(value.visibilityCondition, path);
214	
215	  // file
216	  field.allowTypes = value.allowTypes as string[] | undefined;
217	  field.maxSizeMB = value.maxSizeMB as number | undefined;
218	  field.maxCount = value.maxCount as number | undefined;
219	
220	  // info-text (static text content)
221	  if (value.styleType !== undefined) {
222	    const st = optionalString(value.styleType, path, "styleType");
223	    if (st === "info" || st === "warning" || st === "danger") field.styleType = st;
224	  }
225	  field.text = optionalString(value.text, path, "text");
226	
227	  // user-picker
228	  field.multiple = value.multiple === undefined ? undefined : Boolean(value.multiple);
229	
230	  // subform
231	  if (type === "subform") {
232	    if (depth >= MAX_SUBFORM_DEPTH) {
233	      throw new SchemaParseError(
234	        "SUBFORM_NESTING_TOO_DEEP",
235	        `subform nesting exceeds maximum depth of ${MAX_SUBFORM_DEPTH}`,
236	        path,
237	      );
238	    }
239	    const subSchema = value.subSchema;
240	    if (!isObject(subSchema) || !Array.isArray(subSchema.fields)) {
241	      throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "subform requires subSchema.fields array", path);
242	    }
243	    field.subSchema = {
244	      fields: (subSchema.fields as unknown[]).map((f, i) =>
245	        parseField(f, `${path}.subSchema.fields[${i}]`, depth + 1),
246	      ),
247	    };
248	  }
249	
250	  return field;
251	}
252	
253	// ── Sections ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
254	
255	function parseSection(value: unknown, path: string): SectionSchema {
256	  if (!isObject(value)) {
257	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "section must be an object", path);
258	  }
259	  const id = requireString(value.id, path, "section.id");
260	  const title = requireString(value.title, path, "section.title");
261	
262	  const section: SectionSchema = { id, title, fields: [] };
263	
264	  section.description = optionalString(value.description, path, "description");
265	  section.collapsible = value.collapsible === undefined ? undefined : Boolean(value.collapsible);
266	  section.defaultCollapsed = value.defaultCollapsed === undefined ? undefined : Boolean(value.defaultCollapsed);
267	  section.visibilityCondition = parseVisibilityCondition(value.visibilityCondition, path);
268	
269	  if (!Array.isArray(value.fields)) {
270	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "section.fields must be an array", path);
271	  }
272	  section.fields = (value.fields as unknown[]).map((f, i) => parseField(f, `${path}.fields[${i}]`, 0));
273	
274	  return section;
275	}
276	
277	// ── Approval chain ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
278	
279	function parseApproverRule(value: unknown, path: string): ApproverRule {
280	  if (!isObject(value)) {
281	    throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", "approverRule must be an object", path);
282	  }
283	  const type = value.type;
284	  if (type === "org_structure") {
285	    const relation = value.relation;
286	    if (relation !== "direct_manager" && relation !== "department_manager") {
287	      throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", "org_structure rule requires relation", path);
288	    }
289	    return { type: "org_structure", relation };
290	  }
291	  if (type === "role") {
292	    const roleId = requireString(value.roleId, path, "role.roleId");
293	    return { type: "role", roleId };
294	  }
295	  if (type === "specific") {
296	    const userId = requireString(value.userId, path, "specific.userId");
297	    return { type: "specific", userId };
298	  }
299	  throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", `unknown approver rule type "${String(type)}"`, path);
300	}
301	
302	function parseApprovalChain(value: unknown, path: string): ApprovalChain {
303	  if (!isObject(value) || !Array.isArray(value.nodes)) {
304	    throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", "approvalChain must have a nodes array", path);
305	  }
306	  if (value.nodes.length === 0) {
307	    throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", "approvalChain.nodes must not be empty", path);
308	  }
309	
310	  const seenIds = new Set<string>();
311	  const seenOrders = new Set<number>();
312	
313	  const nodes: ApprovalNode[] = (value.nodes as unknown[]).map((n, i) => {
314	    const nodePath = `${path}.nodes[${i}]`;
315	    if (!isObject(n)) {
316	      throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", "approval node must be an object", nodePath);
317	    }
318	    const id = requireString(n.id, nodePath, "node.id");
319	    if (seenIds.has(id)) {
320	      throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", `duplicate node id "${id}"`, nodePath);
321	    }
322	    seenIds.add(id);
323	
324	    const order = n.order;
325	    if (typeof order !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(order)) {
326	      throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", "node.order must be a finite number", nodePath);
327	    }
328	    if (seenOrders.has(order)) {
329	      throw new SchemaParseError("APPROVAL_CHAIN_INVALID", `duplicate node order ${order}`, nodePath);
330	    }
331	    seenOrders.add(order);
332	
333	    return {
334	      id,
335	      order,
336	      ...(n.label !== undefined ? { label: optionalString(n.label, nodePath, "label") } : {}),
337	      approverRule: parseApproverRule(n.approverRule, `${nodePath}.approverRule`),
338	    };
339	  });
340	
341	  // Deterministic order for the IR.
342	  nodes.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
343	
344	  return { nodes };
345	}
346	
347	// ── Entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
348	
349	/**
350	 * Parse a raw schema (and optional approval chain) into a typed IR.
351	 *
352	 * @param rawSchema  the raw `schema` JSONB value
353	 * @param approvalChain  the raw `approval_chain` JSONB value (optional; validated when present)
354	 */
355	export function parseSchema(rawSchema: unknown, approvalChain?: unknown): ParsedSchema {
356	  if (!isObject(rawSchema)) {
357	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "schema must be an object", "$");
358	  }
359	
360	  const version = rawSchema.schemaVersion;
361	  if (typeof version !== "string" || version.trim() === "") {
362	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_VERSION_MISSING", "schemaVersion is required", "$");
363	  }
364	  if (!isSupportedSchemaVersion(version)) {
365	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_VERSION_UNKNOWN", `unsupported schemaVersion "${version}"`, "$");
366	  }
367	
368	  if (!Array.isArray(rawSchema.sections)) {
369	    throw new SchemaParseError("SCHEMA_STRUCTURE_INVALID", "schema.sections must be an array", "$");
370	  }
371	
372	  const parsed: ParsedSchema = {
373	    schemaVersion: version,
374	    sections: (rawSchema.sections as unknown[]).map((s, i) => parseSection(s, `$.sections[${i}]`)),
375	  };
376	
377	  if (approvalChain !== undefined && approvalChain !== null) {
378	    parsed.approvalChain = parseApprovalChain(approvalChain, "$");
379	  }
380	
381	  return parsed;
382	}
383

Let me define the checkout/lock semantics clearly:
- `POST /templates` — create template, auto-checkout to creator (locked_by = creator, locked_at = now). Body: { name, description?, category?, schema?, approval_chain? }. Status draft.
- `GET /templates` — list with filters category/status/search + pagination (page/pageSize, offset-based). Return items + total.
- `GET /templates/:id` — detail with schema + approval_chain.
- `PUT /templates/:id/schema` — save schema. Validate lock holder (only locked_by can save; if not locked → error; if locked by someone else → 409). Increment version (optimistic lock). Body: { schema, approval_chain? }.
- `POST /templates/:id/checkout` — acquire lock. If already locked by someone else → 409 TEMPLATE_LOCKED. If locked by self → idempotent success.
- `POST /templates/:id/checkin` — release lock. Only lock holder (or admin) can check in.
- `POST /templates/:id/publish` — draft → published. Atomic update status + clear cache (MVP: no cache, but set status). 
- `POST /templates/:id/force-unlock` — admin only, clear lock.

# Server

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://form_engine:form_engine_pass@localhost:5432/form_engine_db
POSTGRES_USER=form_engine
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=form_engine_pass
POSTGRES_DB=form_engine_db

# JWT
JWT_SECRET=change-me-in-production-use-a-strong-random-string
JWT_EXPIRES_IN=7d

# CORS
CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000,http://localhost

# CSRF
CSRF_COOKIE_NAME=xsrf-token

# Logging
LOG_LEVEL=info
---docker-compose---
version: "3.8"

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: form-engine-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-form_engine}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-form_engine_pass}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-form_engine_db}
    # Host port 5433 → container 5432. 5432 is occupied by the native Windows
    # PostgreSQL 18 service on this dev machine.
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/postgres/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-form_engine} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-form_engine_db}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  server:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    container_name: form-engine-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: ${NODE_ENV:-development}
      SERVER_PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-form_engine}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-form_engine_pass}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-form_engine_db}
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:-dev-secret-change-in-production}
      CORS_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost,http://localhost:5173}
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-debug}
    volumes:
      - ./server:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    command: npx nodemon --exec "npx ts-node" src/index.ts --watch src

  client:
    build:
      context: ./client
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    container_name: form-engine-client
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5173:5173"
    volumes:
      - ./client:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    environment:
      VITE_API_BASE_URL: /api/v1
    depends_on:
      - server

  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: form-engine-nginx
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    volumes:
      - ./docker/nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    depends_on:
      - server
      - client

volumes:
  postgres_data:

1	/**
2	 * FormStateManager — the reducer that drives a single form instance's runtime
3	 * state: values / errors / visibility / disabled / touched / dirty / submitting.
4	 *
5	 * Design (docs/design-spec §2.1.2 & §5.3):
6	 *   setValue → update values → recompute visibility (incremental, via the
7	 *   dependency graph) → recompute errors. `touched` is only set true on BLUR
8	 *   (onBlur). `dirty` marks unsaved changes. RESET/RESTORE recover state.
9	 */
10	
11	import { topLevelFields } from "./fields";
12	import type {
13	  AllErrors,
14	  FormAction,
15	  FormState,
16	  FormValues,
17	  ParsedSchema,
18	} from "./types";
19	import {
20	  fieldsReferencing,
21	  validateAll,
22	  validateFieldInContext,
23	  validateSubtree,
24	} from "./validationEngine";
25	import { computeVisibility, recalculateVisibility } from "./visibilityEngine";
26	
27	export function createInitialState(
28	  schema: ParsedSchema,
29	  initialValues: FormValues = {},
30	): FormState {
31	  return {
32	    values: { ...initialValues },
33	    errors: {},
34	    visibility: computeVisibility(schema, initialValues),
35	    disabled: {},
36	    touched: {},
37	    dirty: false,
38	    submitting: false,
39	  };
40	}
41	
42	/** Remove error entries for `prefix` and its dotted descendants. */
43	function clearSubtree(errors: AllErrors, prefix: string): void {
44	  delete errors[prefix];
45	  const dot = `${prefix}.`;
46	  for (const key of Object.keys(errors)) {
47	    if (key.startsWith(dot)) delete errors[key];
48	  }
49	}
50	
51	/** The definition-level key for an error key (strips row indexes). */
52	function definitionKey(key: string): string {
53	  return key
54	    .split(".")
55	    .filter((part) => !/^\d+$/.test(part))
56	    .join(".");
57	}
58	
59	function isVisibleErrorKey(key: string, visibility: Record<string, boolean>): boolean {
60	  return visibility[definitionKey(key)] !== false;
61	}
62	
63	/** Revalidate a field's subtree plus any cross-field dependents. Mutates `errors`. */
64	function revalidateField(
65	  errors: AllErrors,
66	  schema: ParsedSchema,
67	  values: FormValues,
68	  visibility: Record<string, boolean>,
69	  fieldId: string,
70	): void {
71	  const field = topLevelFields(schema).find((f) => f.id === fieldId);
72	  if (field) {
73	    clearSubtree(errors, fieldId);
74	    if (visibility[fieldId] !== false) {
75	      validateSubtree(field, values, fieldId, errors);
76	    }
77	  }
78	
79	  for (const dep of fieldsReferencing(schema, fieldId)) {
80	    delete errors[dep.id];
81	    if (visibility[dep.id] !== false) {
82	      const errs = validateFieldInContext(dep, values);
83	      if (errs.length) errors[dep.id] = errs;
84	    }
85	  }
86	}
87	
88	function filterVisibleErrors(
89	  errors: AllErrors,
90	  visibility: Record<string, boolean>,
91	): AllErrors {
92	  const out: AllErrors = {};
93	  for (const [key, errs] of Object.entries(errors)) {
94	    if (isVisibleErrorKey(key, visibility)) out[key] = errs;
95	  }
96	  return out;
97	}
98	
99	/**
100	 * Create a reducer bound to a parsed schema.
101	 *
102	 * @param schema        the parsed schema (from SchemaParser)
103	 * @param initialValues initial field values (e.g. defaults, or a restored draft)
104	 */
105	export function createFormReducer(schema: ParsedSchema, initialValues: FormValues = {}) {
106	  return function formReducer(state: FormState | undefined, action: FormAction): FormState {
107	    const current = state ?? createInitialState(schema, initialValues);
108	
109	    switch (action.type) {
110	      case "SET_VALUE": {
111	        if (Object.is(current.values[action.fieldId], action.value)) {
112	          return current;
113	        }
114	        const values = { ...current.values, [action.fieldId]: action.value };
115	        const { visibility, affected } = recalculateVisibility(
116	          schema,
117	          values,
118	          action.fieldId,
119	          current.visibility,
120	        );
121	        const errors: AllErrors = { ...current.errors };
122	        for (const id of affected) {
123	          if (visibility[id] === false) clearSubtree(errors, id);
124	        }
125	        revalidateField(errors, schema, values, visibility, action.fieldId);
126	        return { ...current, values, visibility, errors, dirty: true };
127	      }
128	
129	      case "BLUR": {
130	        const touched = { ...current.touched, [action.fieldId]: true };
131	        const errors: AllErrors = { ...current.errors };
132	        revalidateField(errors, schema, current.values, current.visibility, action.fieldId);
133	        return { ...current, touched, errors };
134	      }
135	
136	      case "SET_ERRORS":
137	        return { ...current, errors: action.errors };
138	
139	      case "SET_DISABLED":
140	        return {
141	          ...current,
142	          disabled: { ...current.disabled, [action.fieldId]: action.disabled },
143	        };
144	
145	      case "SET_SUBMITTING":
146	        return { ...current, submitting: action.submitting };
147	
148	      case "VALIDATE_ALL": {
149	        const errors = filterVisibleErrors(validateAll(schema, current.values), current.visibility);
150	        return { ...current, errors };
151	      }
152	
153	      case "RESET":
154	        return createInitialState(schema, initialValues);
155	
156	      case "RESTORE":
157	        return action.state;
158	    }
159	  };
160	}
161	
162	/**
163	 * Thin imperative wrapper around the reducer — convenient for non-React
164	 * consumers and tests. Mirrors the design spec's core methods.
165	 */
166	export class FormStateManager {
167	  private state: FormState;
168	  private reducer: (state: FormState, action: FormAction) => FormState;
169	
170	  constructor(schema: ParsedSchema, initialValues: FormValues = {}) {
171	    this.reducer = createFormReducer(schema, initialValues) as (
172	      state: FormState,
173	      action: FormAction,
174	    ) => FormState;
175	    this.state = createInitialState(schema, initialValues);
176	  }
177	
178	  getState(): FormState {
179	    return this.state;
180	  }
181	
182	  getValue(fieldId: string): unknown {
183	    return this.state.values[fieldId];
184	  }
185	
186	  dispatch(action: FormAction): FormState {
187	    this.state = this.reducer(this.state, action);
188	    return this.state;
189	  }
190	
191	  setValue(fieldId: string, value: unknown): FormState {
192	    return this.dispatch({ type: "SET_VALUE", fieldId, value });
193	  }
194	
195	  blur(fieldId: string): FormState {
196	    return this.dispatch({ type: "BLUR", fieldId });
197	  }
198	
199	  setErrors(errors: AllErrors): FormState {
200	    return this.dispatch({ type: "SET_ERRORS", errors });
201	  }
202	
203	  validateAll(): FormState {
204	    return this.dispatch({ type: "VALIDATE_ALL" });
205	  }
206	
207	  setSubmitting(submitting: boolean): FormState {
208	    return this.dispatch({ type: "SET_SUBMITTING", submitting });
209	  }
210	
211	  reset(): FormState {
212	    return this.dispatch({ type: "RESET" });
213	  }
214	
215	  restore(state: FormState): FormState {

7	/** All fields across every section (depth 0 of the schema). */

9	  return schema.sections.flatMap((section) => section.fields);
10	}
11	
12	/** Child fields of a subform field (empty for non-subform fields). */
13	export function childFields(field: FieldSchema): FieldSchema[] {

1	import { useContext } from "react";
2	import type { FieldSchema } from "form-engine-core";
3	import { FormRenderContext } from "../context";
4	import { objectArrayValue } from "../coerce";
5	import type { FieldComponent } from "../types";
6	
7	function defaultRow(fields: FieldSchema[]): Record<string, unknown> {
8	  const row: Record<string, unknown> = {};
9	  for (const field of fields) {
10	    if (field.defaultValue !== undefined) row[field.id] = field.defaultValue;
11	  }
12	  return row;
13	}
14	
15	/**
16	 * SubForm — a repeatable group of child fields. Rows are stored as an array of
17	 * row objects on the parent value; add/remove rewrites the array through the
18	 * contract's `onChange`, and each child field is rendered recursively via
19	 * `renderField` (from FormRenderContext) with a row-indexed path.
20	 */
21	export const SubForm: FieldComponent = ({
22	  id,
23	  label,
24	  value,
25	  onChange,
26	  error,
27	  disabled,
28	  schema,
29	}) => {
30	  const context = useContext(FormRenderContext);
31	  const rows = objectArrayValue(value);
32	  const childFields = schema.subSchema?.fields ?? [];
33	
34	  const addRow = () => {
35	    onChange([...rows, defaultRow(childFields)]);
36	  };
37	
38	  const removeRow = (index: number) => {
39	    onChange(rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
40	  };
41	
42	  return (
43	    <div className="form-field form-subform" data-field-id={id}>
44	      <div className="form-label">
45	        {label}
46	        {schema.required && (
47	          <span className="form-required" aria-hidden="true">
48	            {" "}
49	            *
50	          </span>
51	        )}
52	      </div>
53	      {error && error.length > 0 && (
54	        <p className="form-error" role="alert">
55	          {error[0].message}
56	        </p>
57	      )}
58	
59	      {rows.length === 0 ? (
60	        <p className="form-help">暂无记录</p>
61	      ) : (
62	        <div className="subform-rows">
63	          {rows.map((_, rowIndex) => (
64	            <div className="subform-row" key={rowIndex}>
65	              <div className="subform-row-fields">
66	                {childFields.map((field) =>
67	                  context?.renderField(field, `${id}.${rowIndex}.${field.id}`),
68	                )}
69	              </div>
70	              <button
71	                type="button"
72	                className="subform-remove"
73	                onClick={() => removeRow(rowIndex)}
74	                disabled={disabled}
75	                aria-label={`删除第 ${rowIndex + 1} 行`}
76	              >
77	                删除
78	              </button>
79	            </div>
80	          ))}
81	        </div>
82	      )}
83	
84	      <button
85	        type="button"
86	        className="subform-add"
87	        onClick={addRow}
88	        disabled={disabled}
89	      >
90	        添加一行
91	      </button>
92	    </div>
93	  );
94	};
95
```

```typescript
import { Router, Request, Response } from "express";
import { getDb } from "../db/connection";
import { AppError } from "../middleware/errorHandler";

const router = Router();

/**
 * Template API (work order 04). All routes are mounted at `/api/v1/templates`.
 *
 * Checkout/checkin implement the exclusive edit lock (CONTEXT.md "签出 / 签入"):
 * exactly one user holds `locked_by` at a time; `PUT …/schema` requires the
 * caller to be that holder. `publish` is a single atomic UPDATE that flips
 * `draft → published` and clears the lock. `force-unlock` is documented as
 * admin-only; role enforcement lands with auth (issue 09), so for now it clears
 * the lock unconditionally — consistent with the MVP's permissive CSRF stance.
 */

interface UserRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
}

interface TemplateRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  category: string | null;
  version: number;
  schema: unknown;
  approval_chain: unknown;
  status: "draft" | "published" | "archived";
  locked_by: string | null;
  locked_at: Date | null;
  created_by: string;
  created_at: Date;
  updated_at: Date;
}

/**
 * Resolve the acting user. The MVP has no auth (issue 09), so identity is taken
 * from an `X-User-Id` header and falls back to the seeded designer (张三) when
 * absent — letting the client work unchanged while integration tests drive
 * different identities through the header.
 */
async function resolveCurrentUser(req: Request): Promise<UserRow> {
  const db = getDb();
  const headerId = req.headers["x-user-id"];
  if (typeof headerId === "string" && headerId.trim() !== "") {
    const user = await db("users").where({ id: headerId.trim() }).first();
    if (!user) {
      throw new AppError("NOT_FOUND", "用户不存在", 404);
    }
    return user;
  }

  const fallback = await db("users")
    .where({ email: "zhangsan@example.com" })
    .first();
  if (!fallback) {
    throw new AppError("NOT_FOUND", "未找到默认演示用户，请先执行 seed", 404);
  }
  return fallback;
}

/**
 * Normalize a DB row into the API shape. The seed stores `schema`/`approval_chain`
 * as JSON strings; rows written through this route store JSONB objects. Parse
 * strings defensively so both shapes read as objects.
 */
function toTemplate(row: Record<string, unknown>): TemplateRow {
  const parse = (value: unknown): unknown =>
    typeof value === "string" ? JSON.parse(value) : value;

  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    name: row.name as string,
    description: (row.description as string | null) ?? null,
    category: (row.category as string | null) ?? null,
    version: Number(row.version),
    schema: parse(row.schema),
    approval_chain: row.approval_chain == null ? null : parse(row.approval_chain),
    status: row.status as TemplateRow["status"],
    locked_by: (row.locked_by as string | null) ?? null,
    locked_at: row.locked_at ? (row.locked_at as Date) : null,
    created_by: row.created_by as string,
    created_at: row.created_at as Date,
    updated_at: row.updated_at as Date,
  };
}

async function findTemplate(id: string): Promise<TemplateRow> {
  const row = await getDb()("form_templates").where({ id }).first();
  if (!row) {
    throw new AppError("NOT_FOUND", "模板不存在", 404);
  }
  return toTemplate(row);
}

async function lockerName(userId: string): Promise<string> {
  const user = await getDb()("users").where({ id: userId }).first();
  return user?.name ?? "其他用户";
}

function clampInt(
  raw: unknown,
  fallback: number,
  min: number,
  max: number,
): number {
  const n = typeof raw === "string" ? parseInt(raw, 10) : Number(raw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.trunc(n)));
}

// ── POST /api/v1/templates — create + auto-checkout ─────────────────────────
router.post("/", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const user = await resolveCurrentUser(req);
  const name = req.body?.name;

  if (typeof name !== "string" || name.trim() === "") {
    throw new AppError("VALIDATION_ERROR", "模板名称不能为空", 422);
  }

  const db = getDb();
  const [created] = await db("form_templates")
    .insert({
      name: name.trim(),
      description: req.body.description ?? null,
      category: req.body.category ?? null,
      schema: req.body.schema ?? { schemaVersion: "1.0.0", sections: [] },
      approval_chain: req.body.approval_chain ?? null,
      status: "draft",
      locked_by: user.id,
      locked_at: db.fn.now(),
      created_by: user.id,
    })
    .returning("*");

  res.status(201).json(toTemplate(created));
});

// ── GET /api/v1/templates — list (filters + offset pagination) ──────────────
router.get("/", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const db = getDb();
  const { category, status, search } = req.query as Record<string, unknown>;

  const page = clampInt(req.query.page, 1, 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
  const pageSize = clampInt(req.query.pageSize, 20, 1, 100);

  const base = db("form_templates");
  if (typeof category === "string" && category !== "") {
    base.where({ category });
  }
  if (typeof status === "string" && status !== "") {
    base.where({ status });
  }
  if (typeof search === "string" && search.trim() !== "") {
    base.whereILike("name", `%${search.trim()}%`);
  }

  const [{ count }] = await base.clone().count<{ count: string }>("*");
  const rows = await base
    .orderBy("created_at", "desc")
    .limit(pageSize)
    .offset((page - 1) * pageSize);

  res.json({
    items: rows.map(toTemplate),
    total: Number(count),
    page,
    pageSize,
  });
});

// ── GET /api/v1/templates/:id — detail ──────────────────────────────────────
router.get("/:id", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json(await findTemplate(req.params.id));
});

// ── PUT /api/v1/templates/:id/schema — save schema (lock holder only) ───────
router.put("/:id/schema", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const user = await resolveCurrentUser(req);
  const template = await findTemplate(req.params.id);

  if (template.locked_by !== user.id) {
    if (template.locked_by == null) {
      throw new AppError("TEMPLATE_LOCKED", "模板未签出，请先签出后编辑", 409);
    }
    throw new AppError(
      "TEMPLATE_LOCKED",
      `模板已被 ${await lockerName(template.locked_by)} 签出`,
      409,
    );
  }

  const schema = req.body?.schema;
  if (typeof schema !== "object" || schema === null || Array.isArray(schema)) {
    throw new AppError("VALIDATION_ERROR", "schema 必须为对象", 422);
  }

  const db = getDb();
  const update: Record<string, unknown> = {
    schema,
    updated_at: db.fn.now(),
    version: db.raw("version + 1"),
  };
  if (req.body.approval_chain !== undefined) {
    update.approval_chain = req.body.approval_chain;
  }

  const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
    .where({ id: template.id })
    .update(update)
    .returning("*");

  res.json(toTemplate(updated));
});

// ── POST /api/v1/templates/:id/checkout — acquire lock ──────────────────────
router.post("/:id/checkout", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const user = await resolveCurrentUser(req);
  const template = await findTemplate(req.params.id);

  if (template.locked_by === user.id) {
    return res.json(template);
  }
  if (template.locked_by != null) {
    throw new AppError(
      "TEMPLATE_LOCKED",
      `模板已被 ${await lockerName(template.locked_by)} 签出`,
      409,
    );
  }

  const db = getDb();
  const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
    .where({ id: template.id })
    .update({ locked_by: user.id, locked_at: db.fn.now(), updated_at: db.fn.now() })
    .returning("*");

  res.json(toTemplate(updated));
});

// ── POST /api/v1/templates/:id/checkin — release lock ───────────────────────
router.post("/:id/checkin", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const user = await resolveCurrentUser(req);
  const template = await findTemplate(req.params.id);

  if (template.locked_by == null) {
    return res.json(template);
  }
  if (template.locked_by !== user.id) {
    throw new AppError(
      "TEMPLATE_LOCKED",
      `仅签出人（${await lockerName(template.locked_by)}）可签入`,
      409,
    );
  }

  const db = getDb();
  const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
    .where({ id: template.id })
    .update({ locked_by: null, locked_at: null, updated_at: db.fn.now() })
    .returning("*");

  res.json(toTemplate(updated));
});

// ── POST /api/v1/templates/:id/publish — draft → published ──────────────────
router.post("/:id/publish", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const template = await findTemplate(req.params.id);

  if (template.status !== "draft") {
    throw new AppError("VALIDATION_ERROR", "仅草稿模板可发布", 400);
  }

  const db = getDb();
  const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
    .where({ id: template.id })
    .andWhere({ status: "draft" })
    .update({
      status: "published",
      locked_by: null,
      locked_at: null,
      updated_at: db.fn.now(),
      version: db.raw("version + 1"),
    })
    .returning("*");

  res.json(toTemplate(updated));
});

// ── POST /api/v1/templates/:id/force-unlock — admin override ────────────────
router.post("/:id/force-unlock", async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const template = await findTemplate(req.params.id);

  const db = getDb();
  const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
    .where({ id: template.id })
    .update({ locked_by: null, locked_at: null, updated_at: db.fn.now() })
    .returning("*");

  res.json(toTemplate(updated));
});

export default router;

    }

    const db = getDb();
    const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
      .where({ id: template.id })
      .andWhere({ status: "draft" })
      .update({
        status: "published",
        locked_by: null,
        locked_at: null,
        updated_at: db.fn.now(),
        version: db.raw("version + 1"),
      })
      .returning("*");

    res.json(toTemplate(updated));
  }),
);

// ── POST /api/v1/templates/:id/force-unlock — admin override ────────────────
router.post(
  "/:id/force-unlock",
  asyncHandler(async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const template = await findTemplate(req.params.id);

    const db = getDb();
    const [updated] = await db("form_templates")
      .where({ id: template.id })
      .update({ locked_by: null, locked_at: null, updated_at: db.fn.now() })
      .returning("*");

    res.json(toTemplate(updated));
  }),
);

export default router;

```
